comment: Kept by hand by the LEAD session, and only by it. This is the lead's record of running agents and queued batches, not a measured fact: scripts/ledger.mjs never reads or checks it, and docs/ledger.html shows it apart from the measured ledger. Each item: { name, brief, models: [ids], status: "running" | "queued" | "done", started: ISO date or null }. Bump updatedAt whenever you edit.
